title: 快濾池反沖洗控制~Rapid-filter backwash control
focus: 濾程、水頭損失、床層膨脹與恢復~Filter runs, head loss, bed expansion and return to service
summary: 本課以濾程、水頭損失、床層膨脹與恢復為主線，從進水顆粒與濾速、床層與孔隙水、累積壓損與截污、濾程終點比較進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。~This course develops filter runs, head loss, bed expansion and return to service through ten connected units, beginning with influent particles and filtration rate, bed and pore water, head-loss growth and retained solids, comparing run endpoints. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

units.title: 進水顆粒與濾速~Influent particles and filtration rate
units.mechanism: 快濾承接前段處理後的顆粒；以實際啟用面積計濾速，不能把停用池算入。~Rapid filters receive particles after upstream treatment; use active area rather than including offline cells in the loading calculation.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Q=100 m³/h；濾池面積=20 m²。模型 v=Q/A，代入得到 5 m/h。適用邊界：表觀過濾速度不等於孔隙水速；實際受濾料與水質限制。~Original teaching assumptions: Q=100 m³/h; filter area=20 m². Model v=Q/A gives 5 m/h. Applicability: Superficial filtration velocity differs from pore velocity and is constrained by media and water quality.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「進水顆粒與濾速」的觀測點。逐池量流量與水頭損失，檢查分配不均。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for influent particles and filtration rate. Measure each filter flow/head loss and check maldistribution. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 一池反洗時仍用全廠面積算濾速。診斷與介入：扣掉停用面積重算濾速，核對各池流量與水質。~All installed area is used while one cell is backwashing. Diagnostic response: Recalculate using online area and check cell flows/quality.
units.misconception: 相同總流量代表每池負荷不變。~Equal total flow means unchanged load in each cell.
units.practice: 只改變 Q:100→120 m³/h，其餘假設固定；結果應由 5 變為 6 m/h。用「進水顆粒與濾速」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Q:100→120 m³/h, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 5 to 6 m/h. Explain the direction using influent particles and filtration rate, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 床層與孔隙水~Bed and pore water
units.mechanism: 砂、無煙煤或其他濾料的層深與孔隙影響通道，孔隙停留時間本身不表示捕集率。~Media depth and porosity influence flow paths; pore residence time alone does not establish capture efficiency.
units.model: 原創教學假設：孔隙率=0.4；床深=0.8 m；濾速=5 m/h。模型 tpore=60εL/v，代入得到 3.84 min。適用邊界：均勻飽和床層孔隙停留時間；不是顆粒捕集效率或消毒接觸時間。~Original teaching assumptions: Porosity=0.4; bed depth=0.8 m; filtration velocity=5 m/h. Model tpore=60εL/v gives 3.84 min. Applicability: Uniform saturated-bed pore residence time, not capture efficiency or disinfection contact time.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「床層與孔隙水」的觀測點。以床層實測厚度、孔隙估計與示蹤曲線交叉檢查。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for bed and pore water. Cross-check measured bed depth and estimated porosity against tracer curves. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 把砂床總體積當作全是水的體積。診斷與介入：核對有效床深、孔隙估計與旁流，另外量出水顆粒。~Bulk bed volume is treated as water volume. Diagnostic response: Check effective depth, porosity estimate and bypass, measuring effluent particles separately.
units.misconception: 水通過孔隙的時間就等於消毒時間。~Pore passage time equals disinfection contact time.
units.practice: 只改變 v:5→6 m/h，其餘假設固定；結果應由 3.84 變為 3.2 min。用「床層與孔隙水」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only v:5→6 m/h, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 3.84 to 3.2 min. Explain the direction using bed and pore water, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 累積壓損與截污~Head-loss growth and retained solids
units.mechanism: 顆粒沉積降低通水能力；分層測壓可辨識表面堵塞、深層截污或流量改變。~Deposits reduce permeability; multi-level pressure measurements distinguish surface plugging, depth loading and changed flow.
units.model: 原創教學假設：濾速 v=5 m/h；床深 L=0.8 m；假想水力傳導係數 K=5 m/h。模型 Δh=vL/K，代入得到 0.8 m。適用邊界：飽和、近似線性 Darcy 關係的教學例；堵塞、分層及非線性流動需另外描述。~Original teaching assumptions: Filtration velocity v=5 m/h; bed depth L=0.8 m; hypothetical hydraulic conductivity K=5 m/h. Model Δh=vL/K gives 0.8 m. Applicability: Teaching example of saturated near-linear Darcy flow; fouling, layering and nonlinear flow require additional description.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「累積壓損與截污」的觀測點。比較進出測壓管水頭並記錄水溫與流量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for head-loss growth and retained solids. Compare inlet/outlet piezometric heads and record temperature and flow. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 壓差上升全歸因濾料堵塞而漏掉流量增加。診斷與介入：比較分層測壓、流量與水溫，區分堵塞與流量變化。~Every pressure rise is blamed on fouling while increased flow is missed. Diagnostic response: Compare multi-level heads, flow and temperature to distinguish clogging from changed flow.
units.misconception: 壓損高代表濾出水必定更乾淨。~Higher head loss necessarily means cleaner filtrate.
units.practice: 只改變 K:5→4 m/h，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.8 變為 1 m。用「累積壓損與截污」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only K:5→4 m/h, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.8 to 1 m. Explain the direction using head-loss growth and retained solids, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 濾程終點比較~Comparing run endpoints
units.mechanism: 濁度穿透、水頭限制與時間限制是不同觸發條件，需比較水質與可用產水。~Turbidity breakthrough, head limits and elapsed time are distinct triggers requiring quality and usable-production comparison.
units.model: 原創教學假設：濾水量=100 m³/h；一個濾程=24 h。模型 Vrun=Qt，代入得到 2400 m³/run。適用邊界：只計毛產水；停洗時間、初濾排放與反洗水另扣。~Original teaching assumptions: Filtration flow=100 m³/h; one run=24 h. Model Vrun=Qt gives 2400 m³/run. Applicability: Gross production only; subtract washing downtime, filter-to-waste and backwash water separately.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「濾程終點比較」的觀測點。同步記錄濾程起訖、流量、初濾排放與水質。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for comparing run endpoints. Synchronize run start/end, flow, filter-to-waste and quality records. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只追求最長運轉時間而忽略穿透。診斷與介入：把終點水質、停洗及初濾損失一併列入可用產水。~Longest runtime is pursued despite breakthrough. Diagnostic response: Include endpoint quality, wash downtime and filter-to-waste in usable output.
units.misconception: 濾程越長永遠越節水。~A longer run always saves water.
units.practice: 只改變 t:24→20 h，其餘假設固定；結果應由 2400 變為 2000 m³/run。用「濾程終點比較」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only t:24→20 h, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 2400 to 2000 m³/run. Explain the direction using comparing run endpoints, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 反洗用水收支~Backwash-water balance
units.mechanism: 反洗強度與時間轉為用水體積；此算式不會給出適用於任何濾料的反洗速率。~Intensity and time determine backwash volume; this calculation supplies no universally suitable wash rate.
units.model: 原創教學假設：反洗速度=30 m/h；面積=20 m²；時間=0.10 h。模型 Vbw=vAt，代入得到 60 m³。適用邊界：假想水量計算，不是反洗操作速度；須依濾料、溫度與膨脹校核。~Original teaching assumptions: Backwash velocity=30 m/h; area=20 m²; time=0.10 h. Model Vbw=vAt gives 60 m³. Applicability: Hypothetical volume, not a prescribed backwash velocity; media, temperature and expansion determine suitability.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「反洗用水收支」的觀測點。比對累積反洗水量、床層膨脹與洗出濁度。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for backwash-water balance. Compare cumulative backwash volume, bed expansion and washwater turbidity. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 將其他濾料或水溫的反洗條件直接複用。診斷與介入：比較水溫、床層膨脹與洗出水，依設備驗證範圍評估。~Wash conditions are copied across different media or temperatures. Diagnostic response: Compare temperature, bed expansion and washwater within validated equipment conditions.
units.misconception: 相同反洗水量一定有相同清洗效果。~Equal backwash volume guarantees equal cleaning.
units.practice: 只改變 t:0.10→0.15 h，其餘假設固定；結果應由 60 變為 90 m³。用「反洗用水收支」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only t:0.10→0.15 h, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 60 to 90 m³. Explain the direction using backwash-water balance, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 床層膨脹量測~Measuring bed expansion
units.mechanism: 量反洗前後床高並比較多個位置，檢查流體化是否均勻及是否有濾料流失。~Measure bed height before/during backwash at several locations to assess uniform fluidization and media loss.
units.model: 原創教學假設：原床高=0.8 m；膨脹後=1.0 m。模型 E=(Hexp-H0)/H0，代入得到 0.25 fraction。適用邊界：均勻床面近似；局部噴湧與濾料流失需另檢查。~Original teaching assumptions: Initial bed depth=0.8 m; expanded depth=1.0 m. Model E=(Hexp-H0)/H0 gives 0.25 fraction. Applicability: Assumes a uniform surface; local boils and media loss need separate checks.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「床層膨脹量測」的觀測點。從多個觀測點比較床高與反洗溫度。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for measuring bed expansion. Compare bed height at several points with backwash temperature. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只看單一角落的床層高度。診斷與介入：在多處量床高與流失濾料，查配水不均。~Only one corner of the bed is observed. Diagnostic response: Measure bed height/media loss at several positions and check uneven distribution.
units.misconception: 膨脹越大就越能保證清潔與完整。~More expansion always guarantees cleaner, intact media.
units.practice: 只改變 Hexp:1.0→1.08 m，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.25 變為 0.35 fraction。用「床層膨脹量測」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Hexp:1.0→1.08 m, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.25 to 0.35 fraction. Explain the direction using measuring bed expansion, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 氣水順序與配水~Air-water sequence and distribution
units.mechanism: 離線演練各設備順序及連鎖，依核准設備程序檢查配水不均；不把教學數值當閥門設定。~Rehearse sequencing/interlocks offline and assess uneven distribution against approved equipment procedures; teaching values are not valve settings.
units.model: 原創教學假設：原床高=0.8 m；膨脹後=1.0 m。模型 E=(Hexp-H0)/H0，代入得到 0.25 fraction。適用邊界：均勻床面近似；局部噴湧與濾料流失需另檢查。~Original teaching assumptions: Initial bed depth=0.8 m; expanded depth=1.0 m. Model E=(Hexp-H0)/H0 gives 0.25 fraction. Applicability: Assumes a uniform surface; local boils and media loss need separate checks.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「氣水順序與配水」的觀測點。從多個觀測點比較床高與反洗溫度。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for air-water sequence and distribution. Compare bed height at several points with backwash temperature. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 同一總水量掩蓋局部噴流與死角。診斷與介入：在多處量床高與流失濾料，查配水不均。~Equal total wash flow hides local jets and dead zones. Diagnostic response: Measure bed height/media loss at several positions and check uneven distribution.
units.misconception: 總反洗流量正常就表示每處受洗相同。~Normal total backwash flow means uniform cleaning everywhere.
units.practice: 只改變 Hexp:1.0→1.08 m，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.25 變為 0.35 fraction。用「氣水順序與配水」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Hexp:1.0→1.08 m, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.25 to 0.35 fraction. Explain the direction using air-water sequence and distribution, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 初濾排放與成熟~Filter-to-waste and ripening
units.mechanism: 反洗後顆粒截留狀態會變動，回到供水前須依實際驗證條件檢查連續水質。~Capture conditions change after washing; verify continuous quality against actual validated requirements before returning water to supply.
units.model: 原創教學假設：初濾排放流量=100 m³/h；假想持續=0.25 h。模型 Vftw=Q×t，代入得到 25 m³。適用邊界：只計排放水量；持續時間不是水質達標門檻，實際回供需依監測及核准程序。~Original teaching assumptions: Filter-to-waste flow=100 m³/h; hypothetical duration=0.25 h. Model Vftw=Q×t gives 25 m³. Applicability: Waste-water volume only; duration is not a quality pass criterion, and return to supply requires monitoring/approved procedure.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「初濾排放與成熟」的觀測點。對齊排放流量、連續濁度與閥位紀錄，辨識復原期。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for filter-to-waste and ripening. Align waste flow, continuous turbidity and valve-state records to identify recovery. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 以反洗結束時間直接判定水質恢復。診斷與介入：以連續水質確認復原，將初濾排放從淨產水扣除。~Wash completion time is used as proof of restored quality. Diagnostic response: Confirm recovery with continuous quality and subtract filter-to-waste from net production.
units.misconception: 反洗完成就必定可立刻進入清水池。~Backwash completion always permits immediate delivery to the clearwell.
units.practice: 只改變 t:0.25→0.40 h，其餘假設固定；結果應由 25 變為 40 m³。用「初濾排放與成熟」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only t:0.25→0.40 h, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 25 to 40 m³. Explain the direction using filter-to-waste and ripening, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 廢水回收與淨產水~Waste recycle and net production
units.mechanism: 扣掉反洗與初濾排放後再算淨產水，回收流需納入上游污染與水力負荷。~Subtract backwash/filter-to-waste for net production and include recycle pollutant/hydraulic loads upstream.
units.model: 原創教學假設：總過濾水=2400 m³/d；反洗水=100；初濾排放=20 m³/d。模型 Qnet=Qgross-Qbw-Qwaste，代入得到 2280 m³/d。適用邊界：相同日的水量邊界；回收水若返回進水不可重複算淨產水。~Original teaching assumptions: Gross filtrate=2400 m³/d; backwash=100; filter-to-waste=20 m³/d. Model Qnet=Qgross-Qbw-Qwaste gives 2280 m³/d. Applicability: Same-day water balance; returned washwater cannot be counted twice as net product.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「廢水回收與淨產水」的觀測點。用各支線水表重建全週期收支。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for waste recycle and net production. Reconstruct the full-cycle balance from branch meters. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 循環水重複算成新產水。診斷與介入：分列毛產水、反洗、初濾排放與回流水，避免重複計數。~Recycled water is counted repeatedly as new production. Diagnostic response: Separate gross production, backwash, filter-to-waste and recycle without double-counting.
units.misconception: 反洗回收不會增加任何上游負荷。~Backwash recycle adds no upstream burden.
units.practice: 只改變 Qbw:100→140 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 2280 變為 2240 m³/d。用「廢水回收與淨產水」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Qbw:100→140 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 2280 to 2240 m³/d. Explain the direction using waste recycle and net production, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 維護後多指標驗證~Multi-indicator verification after maintenance
units.mechanism: 同時比較壓損、濁度、床層深度、濾程與淨產水，才能區分洗淨、通道化及濾料流失。~Compare head loss, turbidity, media depth, run duration and net production to distinguish cleaning, channeling and media loss.
units.model: 原創教學假設：濾速 v=5 m/h；床深 L=0.8 m；假想水力傳導係數 K=5 m/h。模型 Δh=vL/K，代入得到 0.8 m。適用邊界：飽和、近似線性 Darcy 關係的教學例；堵塞、分層及非線性流動需另外描述。~Original teaching assumptions: Filtration velocity v=5 m/h; bed depth L=0.8 m; hypothetical hydraulic conductivity K=5 m/h. Model Δh=vL/K gives 0.8 m. Applicability: Teaching example of saturated near-linear Darcy flow; fouling, layering and nonlinear flow require additional description.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「維護後多指標驗證」的觀測點。比較進出測壓管水頭並記錄水溫與流量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for multi-indicator verification after maintenance. Compare inlet/outlet piezometric heads and record temperature and flow. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 壓損降低被當作唯一清洗成功證據。診斷與介入：比較分層測壓、流量與水溫，區分堵塞與流量變化。~Lower head loss is the sole evidence of successful cleaning. Diagnostic response: Compare multi-level heads, flow and temperature to distinguish clogging from changed flow.
units.misconception: 更低壓損一定代表濾池恢復良好。~Lower head loss always means a well-restored filter.
units.practice: 只改變 K:5→4 m/h，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.8 變為 1 m。用「維護後多指標驗證」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only K:5→4 m/h, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.8 to 1 m. Explain the direction using multi-indicator verification after maintenance, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.
